name: Aquaguard Enrich Crystal Booster UV
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Crystal Booster is a premium UV + UF water purifier with a built-in Zero Pressure Pump, advanced 9-stage purification, and 4-in-1 Active Copper Technology.
intro: The Aquaguard Enrich Crystal Booster is a high-performance UV + UF water purifier designed for low TDS water (up to 200 ppm). Featuring a built-in Zero Pressure Pump, advanced 9-stage purification, NanoPore 2X Filter Technology, and 4-in-1 Active Copper enrichment, it delivers safe, healthy, and mineral-rich drinking water. With a 2-year filter life and 6-litre storage capacity, it offers reliable purification with minimal maintenance.
features: Built-in Zero Pressure Pump for consistent purification even at low water pressure.
9-Stage Purification with NanoPore filters, UV e-Boiling, and Ultra Filtration.
NanoPore 2X Filter Technology protects against chlorine, organic chemicals, bacteria, viruses, and cysts.
4-in-1 Active Copper Technology enriches water with Copper, Calcium, Magnesium, and Zinc.
2-Year Filter Life (up to 10,000 litres under standard test conditions).
Mega Sediment Filter extends filter life by removing dust, dirt, and mud particles.
6-Litre Storage Tank for uninterrupted access to purified water.
Suitable for wall-mounted or tabletop installation.
